How it works

From request to departure, all online

No need to come to an office: choose or describe the trip, receive the proposal and book remotely.

1Choose or tell us

Find the proposal you like, or write to us with destination, period and number of people.

2Receive the proposal

We send you a clear quote, with what is included and what is not.

3Book and go

You confirm the proposal and we follow you until departure.

Why book with us

A simple way to organise your trip

Clear proposals

Every quote states what is included and what is not, with no hidden surprises.

Tailor-made too

If you cannot find the right package, we build it with you.

All remote

For every group

Couples, families, friends, schools and companies.

Tailor-made

Have a trip in mind? We build it with you

Tell us the destination (even just an idea), the period, how many of you there are and the budget: we reply with a proposal.

  • Trips for couples, families and friends
  • School trips and trips for associations
  • Corporate trips, incentives and team building

Ask for a quote

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How do I book?

Write to us through the form or on WhatsApp: we reply with a proposal and, if you like it, we agree the steps to confirm.

Is the quote free?

Yes, the quote is free and with no obligation.

Can I ask for a trip I cannot see on the site?

Of course: tailor-made trips are our normal way of working. Ask for a quote.

What is included in the price?

Every proposal clearly states what is included and what is not. If something is unclear, just ask.

Contact

Where do you want to go?

Tell us the destination, the period and how many of you there are: we will reply with a proposal.
